notice: Guidance explains what evidence is missing and how to collect it. It never changes a recorded verdict.

measured_pass.label: Passed within scope
measured_pass.text: The check produced evidence and passed its recorded rules. Other risks may remain.

flagged.label: Flagged, needs review
flagged.text: The check produced evidence of a possible problem. A person should confirm it before calling it a defect.

confirmed_defect.label: Confirmed by review
confirmed_defect.text: A reviewer kept this flagged result after reading its evidence.

review_cleared.label: Cleared by human review
review_cleared.text: A reviewer marked the original flag as a false positive. The original result is kept in the audit history.

declaration.label: Declaration only
declaration.text: A control is declared in the supplied files. Whether it works needs a behavior test.

insufficient_evidence.label: Finished, not enough evidence
insufficient_evidence.text: The scanner finished but the supplied files did not contain enough evidence to score this check.

tool_unavailable.label: Tool unavailable
tool_unavailable.text: The scanner or its offline database was not available on this computer, so nothing was checked.

tool_error.label: Tool error
tool_error.text: The scanner started but its output could not be used. No pass was inferred.

missing_input.label: Input missing
missing_input.text: The file or connection this check needs was not supplied.

not_attempted.label: Not attempted
not_attempted.text: The test stopped or was interrupted before this check ran.

unverified.label: Not verified
unverified.text: No evidence was recorded for this check.

causes.target_information: Information missing from the bot's files

hardcoded_secrets.title: Hard-coded secrets
hardcoded_secrets.source_scope: Gitleaks rules over the uploaded source.
hardcoded_secrets.why_unverified: The only matches were model names or other context that needs a person to review.
required_evidence: The cited source lines reviewed by a person
hardcoded_secrets.owner_action: Review each cited line. Rotate any real key and move it to a secret store.
hardcoded_secrets.next_test: Rerun White-box testing after removing real keys.

unsafe_patterns.title: Unsafe code patterns
unsafe_patterns.why_unverified: Semgrep could not complete or no supported files were inspected.
required_evidence: Supported source files (.py, .js, .ts)
unsafe_patterns.owner_action: Include the application source files in the ZIP.

python_security.title: Python security issues
required_evidence: Python source files
python_security.owner_action: Include the Python source, or ignore this check for a non-Python bot.
python_security.next_test: Rerun White-box testing with the Python source.

dependency_vulnerabilities.title: Dependency vulnerabilities
dependency_vulnerabilities.source_scope: OSV Scanner over dependency manifests and lockfiles, using an offline database.
dependency_vulnerabilities.why_unverified: Package versions were missing, unresolved or placeholders, so advisories cannot be matched to installed versions.
required_evidence: A lockfile or pinned inventory with exact versions (for example requirements.txt with ==, poetry.lock, uv.lock or package-lock.json)
An offline OSV database that covers every listed package
dependency_vulnerabilities.owner_action: Commit a lockfile with exact versions, or export the deployed environment (pip freeze or npm ls) into the ZIP.
dependency_vulnerabilities.next_test: Rerun White-box testing; confirm the deployed versions match the lockfile.

container_vulnerabilities.title: Container and dependency targets (Trivy)
container_vulnerabilities.source_scope: Trivy filesystem scan of lockfiles and container/infrastructure configuration. This is not an image scan.
container_vulnerabilities.why_unverified: Trivy finished but found no lockfile or container configuration it supports, so there was nothing to judge.
required_evidence: A supported lockfile (for example poetry.lock, Pipfile.lock, package-lock.json, yarn.lock)
A Dockerfile or Kubernetes/Compose configuration for misconfiguration checks
container_vulnerabilities.owner_action: Add the lockfile and the Dockerfile the bot is deployed with. Studio does not build or scan uploaded images.
container_vulnerabilities.next_test: Rerun White-box testing. A built-image scan needs a separate, isolated adapter that Studio does not have yet.

prompt_injection_paths.title: Prompt injection paths
prompt_injection_paths.source_scope: Semgrep rules that look for untrusted text placed into prompts.
prompt_injection_paths.why_unverified: Semgrep could not complete or no supported files were inspected.
required_evidence: Source files that build prompts
prompt_injection_paths.next_test: Pair with Black-box testing injection cases on the running bot.

guardrail_path.title: Guardrail on the response path
guardrail_path.source_scope: Limited text rules looking for a guardrail, moderation or output-validation call.
guardrail_path.why_unverified: The limited source rules found no guardrail call. That does not prove there is none, and a call in code would still not prove it works.
required_evidence: The written policy: which requests must be refused and which must be allowed
A running, authorized test endpoint for the bot
guardrail_path.owner_action: Point Studio at the guardrail function or policy file, and share a test endpoint with written permission to test.
guardrail_path.next_test: Run Black-box testing Guardrails cases and Gray-box testing declared-behavior checks against the endpoint.

tool_permissions.title: Tool permissions and ownership
tool_permissions.source_scope: Limited text rules looking for an allowlist, confirmation or approval control.
tool_permissions.why_unverified: Tool handlers and order ID or phone checks were found, but nothing shows the caller is authenticated and owns the record.
required_evidence: The tool list with each tool's allowed callers (Gray-box Tools input)
Two synthetic test accounts on an isolated test endpoint
Tool-call logs showing whether a tool actually ran
tool_permissions.owner_action: Supply a tools definition with permissions, and set up two synthetic test users who must not see each other's orders.
tool_permissions.next_test: Run Gray-box tool misuse and trace checks. A bot saying it cannot do something is not proof the tool did not run.

pii_logging.title: Private data in logs
pii_logging.source_scope: Limited text rules looking for log statements that mention private fields.
pii_logging.why_unverified: No deployed log or redaction evidence was supplied.
required_evidence: Logs captured after a Gray-box canary chat, carrying the same run ID
pii_logging.owner_action: Run a Gray-box canary chat, then export the bot's logs from that time window and attach them to the same test.
pii_logging.next_test: Use Attach updated test logs on the Gray-box test. A partial log cannot prove anything about other logging paths.

retention.title: Data retention and expiry
retention.source_scope: Limited text rules looking for retention, TTL or expiry settings.
retention.why_unverified: Sessions are kept in memory with a manual reset, but no automatic expiry setting or test was found.
required_evidence: The retention or TTL configuration
A controlled test environment where a synthetic session can be created and checked after expiry
retention.owner_action: Document the retention period and provide a test environment. Do not use real customer sessions.
retention.next_test: Create a synthetic session, wait past the TTL, and confirm it is gone.

model_config.title: Model configuration
model_config.source_scope: A narrow text rule that looks for an unpinned 'latest' model alias. It is not a general model validator.
model_config.why_unverified: The rule only checks for a 'latest' alias. No expected model was declared and no response metadata was compared.
required_evidence: The expected provider and model name
Response or trace metadata that reports the model actually used
model_config.owner_action: State the expected model in the Gray-box Configuration input and enable model metadata in the bot's logs.
model_config.next_test: Run Gray-box model drift checks with correlated logs. Studio will not guess a model from answer style.

timeouts_retries.title: Timeouts and retries
timeouts_retries.source_scope: Limited text rules looking for timeout, retry or fallback settings.
timeouts_retries.why_unverified: Error handling or a library default does not show that a slow or failing provider is handled within a bounded time.
required_evidence: The configured timeout and retry limits
A test environment where the provider can be made slow or return 429/5xx errors
timeouts_retries.owner_action: Set explicit timeout and retry limits and share a test environment with a controllable provider stub.
timeouts_retries.next_test: Measure response deadlines and retry counts against the slow/error stub.

endpoint_controls.title: Endpoint access and rate controls
endpoint_controls.source_scope: Limited text rules looking for authentication or rate-limit declarations.
endpoint_controls.why_unverified: A matching line was found, but it may handle an upstream provider limit rather than limit incoming requests.
required_evidence: The authentication and inbound rate-limit configuration
An authorized test endpoint and a synthetic user
endpoint_controls.owner_action: Confirm which code limits incoming requests and checks session ownership.
endpoint_controls.next_test: Send authorized and unauthorized synthetic requests and record the responses.

ci_safety.title: Safety tests in CI
ci_safety.source_scope: Text rules over .github/workflows files that name safety test tools.
ci_safety.why_unverified: The ZIP had no CI workflow that names safety, guardrail or injection tests.
required_evidence: The CI workflow files
A link to a CI run for the exact commit being tested
ci_safety.owner_action: Add a CI job that runs safety tests and share the run link for the tested commit.
ci_safety.next_test: Rerun White-box testing with the workflow; attach the run link. Studio's own CI does not prove the bot's CI.

_default.title: Gray-box check
_default.source_scope: Private inputs you supply, used to target chat tests.
_default.why_unverified: The private input this check needs was not supplied, or no matching behavior was recorded.
required_evidence: The private input named for this check

_default.title: Black-box chat test
_default.source_scope: Conversations with the running bot, judged by the selected AI judge.
_default.why_unverified: The bot could not be reached or the judge could not score the answer.
required_evidence: A working chat link or API endpoint
An available judge
_default.owner_action: Check the bot connection and judge settings.
